entries.origin_analysis: CSOS Opportunity Atlas v1 ranked the fixed F_ASIAN_RANGE_SWEEP variant as a 545-opportunity, 4/4-positive-fold liquidity-sweep mechanism. Phase 2 first reproduced the Atlas event identity exactly, then translated the unchanged signal and 12-bar hold to first executable Raw Bid/Ask ticks.
entries.causal_hypothesis: After the completed 00:00-07:00 UTC Asian range is formed, a completed M15 bar that sweeps an Asian extreme and closes back inside creates a short-horizon liquidity rejection edge opposite the sweep and can complement B02/F05 loss states.
target_failure_mode: B02/F05 negative days during post-Asian liquidity rejection
B02/F05 drawdown states lacking an independent reversal payoff
portfolio concentration around London and New York transitions
pre_result_predictions: Reproduce all 545 Atlas opportunities with zero identity mismatch.
Realistic first-tick Bid/Ask execution remains combined-net positive with PF at least 1.05.
At least three of four half-year folds remain positive and the minimum fold remains at least minus JPY1000.
Top-five winner removal and plus-one-pip spread stress remain nonnegative.
B02/F05 negative-day contribution is positive and additive portfolio MDD is non-worse than baseline.
entries.decision: NO_PORTABLE_CANDIDATE. The exact executable candidate passed every preregistered Research portable gate except portfolio_mdd_nonworse: additive B02/F05 portfolio MDD increased from JPY40487 to JPY40548. No candidate freeze, Core implementation, MT4 test, or 2025 access is authorized.
falsified_or_unsupported_claims: A positive standalone net, PF and 4/4 fold breadth are sufficient to authorize Asian Range Sweep as the third strategy.
The Liquidity Sweep family-level MDD improvement can be attributed to F_ASIAN_RANGE_SWEEP alone.
retained_findings: Atlas identity is reproducible exactly at 545/545 events.
The unchanged mechanism remains standalone positive after first-tick Bid/Ask execution.
The candidate contributes JPY18055 on B02/F05 negative days and has negative daily correlation with both B02 and F05.
The long side is profitable while the short side is negative, but side exclusion was not permitted or adopted.
The full unfiltered candidate fails the non-worse portfolio MDD gate by JPY61.
prohibited_reuse: Do not implement or run this candidate in Core or MT4.
Do not access or use 2025 to rescue thresholds, sides, sessions or hold time.
Do not remove the short side, London bucket, losing months or event-specific dates post hoc.
Do not combine F_PREVIOUS_DAY_SWEEP or family-level Liquidity Sweep results with this candidate.
Do not claim production authorization from positive standalone economics.
successor_questions: Which next CSOS family has an independently preregistered mechanism and can improve portfolio MDD rather than only net and PF?
